verdict.rationale: Moneybird is accounting software, so locking closed periods is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions period closing, locking or reopening. The cited items cover authentication, contacts, MCP/CLI, webhooks, invoicing and tax submission, none of which concern period locks.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can lock closed periods so prior-period numbers cannot change without an explicit reopening
